kaggle.no_projects: Create a project to store files and notebooks.
kaggle.local_files_hint: Only selected files are copied. This local CPU kernel has no internet access.
kaggle.remote_hint: A private CPU run sends this notebook snapshot and the selected Kaggle data sources. Local variables and other files are not transferred.
kaggle.api_fields_hint: Advanced fields use the names from the official Kaggle API. Competition rules must be accepted on Kaggle.
kaggle.draft_storage_full: Draft storage is full. Export your notebook now.
kaggle.draft_restored: Recovered an unsaved draft. Saving checks its original revision.
kaggle.inert_output: This output type is preserved for export.
kaggle.start_kernel_first: Start the local kernel and wait until it is ready.
kaggle.state_lost: Kernel stopped or restarted. Variables are lost; no code was rerun.
kaggle.conflict: A newer version exists. Your draft is preserved; export it before reopening.

kaggle.keep_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved secret
kaggle.policy_help: Grants apply to the agent and Desktop. Read-only blocks remote changes and execution. Downloads also require filesystem write access. Changes to public resources require publication permission.
kaggle.credentials_help: One Kaggle account per installation. Secrets are stored only in the Vault. The connection test uses saved credentials. Save policy changes with the main Save button.
kaggle.owners_help: Empty means only your own account. Enter additional owners separated by commas.
kaggle.local_help: AuraGo manages an isolated Docker container for each session. Python, Docker and filesystem writes must be enabled. Closing a window preserves the session until its idle timeout.

config.section.kaggle.label: Kaggle
config.section.kaggle.desc: Kaggle resources, notebooks and optional local Python execution.
config.kaggle.enabled_help: Turns the Kaggle integration on or off for the agent and Desktop.
config.kaggle.read_only_help: Blocks every change and every run on Kaggle; only reading stays possible.
config.kaggle.auth_mode_help: Choose whether to sign in with an API token or with legacy username and key credentials.
config.kaggle.owner_help: Your Kaggle username; it is used for your own datasets, models and notebooks.
config.kaggle.api_token_help: Paste a new Kaggle API token to replace the saved one; it is stored only in the Vault.
config.kaggle.legacy_key_help: Paste a legacy Kaggle API key to replace the saved one; it is stored only in the Vault.
config.kaggle.allow_download_help: Lets the agent download datasets, models and competition files.
config.kaggle.allow_create_help: Lets the agent create new datasets, models and notebooks.
config.kaggle.allow_update_help: Lets the agent change existing resources and upload new versions.
config.kaggle.allow_publish_help: Lets the agent make resources public or change resources that are already public.
config.kaggle.allow_delete_help: Lets the agent delete resources on Kaggle.
config.kaggle.allow_submit_help: Lets the agent submit results to Kaggle competitions.
config.kaggle.allow_remote_execute_help: Lets the agent start notebook runs on Kaggle's servers.
config.kaggle.allow_gpu_help: Allows Kaggle runs to request a GPU accelerator.
config.kaggle.allow_tpu_help: Allows Kaggle runs to request a TPU accelerator.
config.kaggle.allow_internet_help: Allows Kaggle runs to access the internet.
config.kaggle.local_enabled_help: Turns the local Jupyter runtime on or off.
config.kaggle.allow_local_execute_help: Lets the agent run code cells in the local runtime.
config.kaggle.local_internet_help: Allows code in the local runtime to reach the internet; without it the kernel stays offline.
config.kaggle.max_transfer_help: Largest single download or upload that is accepted, in MiB.
config.kaggle.max_storage_help: Total disk space all Kaggle projects may use together, in MiB.
config.kaggle.max_remote_jobs_help: How many Kaggle runs may be active at the same time.
config.kaggle.remote_timeout_help: Minutes after which a Kaggle run counts as timed out.
config.kaggle.request_timeout_help: Seconds to wait for each Kaggle API call before giving up.
config.kaggle.max_sessions_help: How many local notebook sessions may run at the same time.
config.kaggle.cpu_cores_help: CPU cores reserved for each local session.
config.kaggle.memory_help: Memory limit for each local session, in MiB.
config.kaggle.idle_timeout_help: Minutes of inactivity after which a local session is stopped.
config.kaggle.cell_timeout_help: Maximum run time of a single cell in minutes before it is stopped.
